summary: This informational memo discusses requirements for renumbering with stateless DHCPv6. Hosts using stateless address autoconfiguration get their address automatically but need DHCPv6 for settings such as DNS and NTP, so the document describes how those settings should be updated when a network changes.

eli5.summary: If a neighbourhood changes its street numbers, everyone must learn the new ones. This document discusses how computers should refresh extra network settings when that happens.

questions: how do ipv6 hosts update dns settings after renumbering
